content: Poloa Yuta veane omainaya vayapi Yisasi kanale mono kea huhaleno hamapai-maine.
Nagaya Polona Yuta vea omainaya veamogatama lamaya hisuafe Yisasi Kalaisife lamahanepaugeya nofila hunatenagena Anumayamoa kanale hu-lateneafe nagesa havina nunamu nehue.
Anumaya Kotia Yuta vea omainaya veamogamina tamakaila agaia kayone yamaahe tamahapaisuafene huno hunatenegetama tamakaya ago havimainafi?

Hunateneno nayoma falaki-mainea kea Anumaya Kotia hu falote huno nahapaigena havitena aupaa avo kaena tamahapai-mainogi hapalitama havinutamahena Kalaisifema falakino hanea kea havilinoa aepaa havigahae.
Havigahagi nayoma mainaya veamoya anima falaki-mainea kea ohavinayane meni kanafina Alu Aotage Avamumoa Aposolo vayaene amaune vayaaene ago tahapai-maine.

Manima falaki-mainea kemoa mage huno humaine Yisasi kanale mono kea haviya amakupi malenayafe Yuta vea omainaya veamoya menia Yuta veanene nagoke veane maineya Yisasi Kalaisiene ailokaeya mainageno Anumaya Kotia Hulamategahue. huno hulokiya vai-malenea ya ali-mainae.
Anumaya Kotia nagaifena Yisasia hulatenea kanale mono kea hamapaiyo. huno hunateteno kayone yamaaene tokiyaaene mani aliya alisuafene huno namine.

Namineanagiya mukia Yisasina amaku aminaya veamoya nagaseya maigena nagayama osi nafane kana kano mainogeno Anumaya Kotia kayone hunateteno Kalaisina ohavunamaa kanale yamaa kanale taya hisia yafe Yuta vea omainaya veane hamapaisua-fene huno hunatene.
Anumaya Kotia mukia yana talo humaleteno Nago kavala maa hugahue. huno humainea kea falaki-maleneane. Mani falaki-malenea kea hufalote hisugeya mukia veamoya agayama hisia kea havisae huno hunatene.

Hunategeya Yisasi veamoya anima falaki-mainea kea ago havimainayafe mukia ikapinaga kava veanene ensole vayaene Kefo Avamuyagaene ageteya Anumaya Kotia tusiya huno alu kava alu kava hisia kanale agu agesa hane. huya havisae huno Anumaya Kotia anima falaki-mainea kea amaveli-maine.

Ani kavala Anumaya Kotia ehema ma mopama talo ohunea kanafina Ma kava huna Yisasi Kalaisina hutesugeno amaku amamena aligatigahie. huno hu-maineanagino Anumayati Yisasife havita tagupi maleta tametiti humainona yateti kolia ohuta Yisasiene aigamaeta maineta ke huta havinegone.
Ani yafe musetami nehugi tamakai tamaya hua yateti nagata aiya yana falote hunateneafe tamaipamoa haviyana ohinagetama Yisasi kea oataletama tamayama nehua yafena muse hiho.
Poloa Efesusi veane tokiyaage huya maisayafe nunamuna humaine.
Anumayamoa kanale hu-lateneafe nagesa nehavina nagaya Nenafatega naleya aye kofa huna havinegoe.
Ani Nenafa mukia agaia afamoyaga ikapinaga mainaya afamoene mopale mainaya afamoene tamagelafa amakia malene.
Mage huna Anumayamotega nunamuna nehue Tokiyaage hale yayagakaa kasagoya hanea yapiti Alu Aotage Avamukamona tamamisanageno amakupi maisia yafe amaku amakesa alilokiya vaimatesane.

Yisasife ago tamakupi malenaya yafe Kalaisia no aepagino tamakuafi maineanagitama yosamona hafuyaamoma mopafima taviteno atafa huno lokiya hulia kava hutama Anumaya Kotina hau ayamopafi nehaiya yapi hafuya kana tavitama atafa hutama maisae.

Mainetama mukia Yisasina alu aotage veanene Kalaisina hau ayamopafima nehaiya yana tusia ala yakefa hanea yafe tamaku tamakesa tokiyaage vaitama haviho. Ani yamoa ayaaya huno anale haiteno eteno afepi tavi-mainea yana tusia yakefa haneafe havisae huna Anumayamotega havinegoe.

Tamakaya Kalaisima hau ayamopafima nehaiya yafena havilama hisae huna havine-goanagi mani yana tusia ala yakefa haneafe ma mopale maineta mukia tama yafena havilama ohugahunagi havisae huna Anumayamotega havinegoe. Havisayana Anumaya Kotina aepaamoene tokiyaamoene tamakai tamakupi male havate-lamatesie huna Anumayamotega havinegoe.
Anumaya Kotina tokiyaamoa tagai tagupi aliyana nealia yateti tagesa havita havigesuna yaene alu ya alu yaene tusia ala yakefa hulategahie.
Tagayama Yisasi anagamogata Yisasi Kalaisiene aigamaeta Anumaya Kotiga kagia alisaga hume kanaaene kanaaene hanege hanege huno hanesie huta kahavi-negone. Tamage.
